quest.title: Hoarse Echoes
quest.description: You visit Cheven at the agreed-upon time. At her invitation, you decide to see the former master artisan Tlazolli.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x375, Mora x32625, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

chapter.num: A Prayer for Blessings, Told to Crested Peaks: Act II
chapter.title: Hoarse Echoes

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Oh, you're early! Looking forward to your gift?

choices.text: We're just happy to visit Tlazolli and Nechca.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! Nechca's been so sick, and Tlazolli had to give up what she loves...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Things might be getting better, but they could probably still use some cheering up.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Haha, I've already asked someone to swing by and let Tlazolli know we're coming. She's probably made all the necessary preparations.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Let's go, then. Do you mind watching the store, Imix? I'll be right back.

choices.text: Well, I am curious...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon too... But we're also here to see how Nechca's doing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It can't be easy to recover from such a serious illness. And then there's Tlazolli...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She had to give up what she loves... We just want to cheer them up!

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Here we are. Nice house, right? Gimme a sec, I'll go knock.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: ...Tlazolli? Are you home? Open the door!

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: That's strange... Huh, the door's locked, but she shouldn't be out at this time of day.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Hey, Nechca? Nechca? It's me, Cheven. Open up, please.

choices.text: (No response...)

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Still, I told Tlazolli we were coming... Maybe she had to take Nechca out to get some medicine?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, what's that over there? Looks like a Tepetlisaur nest.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: That's right. Tlazolli has a Tepetlisaur companion. If I remember right, its name is... Iengu?

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: When she was still in the forging business, she'd often have Iengu help with some digging work.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: But since Nechca fell ill, she hasn't let it dig much recently...

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Wait a minute. What the...? This place is a mess! Iengu's nowhere to be seen, either.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, look at all these broken boxes! Something terrible must have happened...

choices.text: Let's take a closer look.
You stay here, Cheven.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Oh... Alright! I'll just... find a place to hide for now!

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: How is it that every single time Imix tells me not to go someplace dangerous, I end up running into danger? It's like her words have some sort of power over me... Maybe it's the Wayob's doing.

choices.text: Need me to break down the door?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What if something happened to the two of them? What if Nechca got worse again...

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Let's not overthink things. They were doing just fine the last time I was here. Nechca was sleeping soundly in her room.

talks.objective: Look for clues related to Tlazolli or Iengu

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, there really is a Tepetlisaur up here. Might not be Tlazolli's companion, though...

choices.text: At least it doesn't seem to be in any danger.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... Paimon still doesn't see any sign of Tlazolli...

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}! Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's Cheven's voice!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Looks like there's someone next to her.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Come down, quick! Tlazolli's here!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? We just got up here, and Tlazolli's back already? What a coincidence...

choices.text: Either way, let's get down there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Why's the Tepetlisaur coming along — Whoa, hey, hey, don't run, you'll hit us!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You descend the mountain with the Tepetlisaur...

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Iengu, come here... Are you being naughty again?

response.speaker: Iengu
response.text: Roar...

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: That's a good Saurian. You must be hungry. Sorry... I'll whip up something for you later.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Alright, run along and play now. I'll come along in a sec.

response.speaker: Iengu
response.text: Roar!

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Sorry, you two. I was waiting for you at home when Nechca... Well, she snuck out and ran off by herself.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: She said she just wanted to pick some flowers for our guests.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: But, she ended up getting lost along the way... Luckily, I managed to find her before long.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is she alright?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Cheven told us she was just starting to get better...

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: She's still very weak. The shock and the cold wind certainly didn't help, so she ended up with a slight fever. I gave her some medicine, and now she's in bed.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: But, it's nothing a good night's rest can't fix.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: That said, she won't be able to meet you today. I'm sorry you came all this way for nothing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry about it! We know she's still recovering. Cheven told us how serious her illness was.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Her health definitely comes first! We were just dropping by to check on her.

choices.text: Is she all better now?

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: ...Well, she can at least speak to me and go about her day normally.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: That's already more than I could ask for...

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Hey, cheer up! This is supposed to be a happy occasion!

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: We do appreciate that she tried to welcome us with flowers. Anyway, Tlazolli, about the thing I was telling you before...

choices.text: The gift!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! What did you get us?

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Well, it's a Blazegem Inscription. I made it from the purest ore, so it's almost completely resistant to erosion.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: The techniques used to make it are all rooted in Ancient Name forging.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, it's like a simplified version of an Ancient Name?

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Heh, don't say that, or the Wayob might smite me. The process just uses a few of the same techniques and materials.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: When I first made one, I didn't think it could serve any practical purpose, apart from the erosion resistance and the general aesthetic.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: But, then Cheven suggested using these crystals to make a special kind of "ornament"...

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: "Blazegem Inscriptions made by an Ancient Name artisan, engraved with words that never fade."

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Quite the sales pitch, don't you think?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, that description really does make it seem special...

choices.text: You've got a good eye for business...

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Haha, Tlazolli's Blazegem Inscriptions really are special, though.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Word of mouth isn't always reliable. As information gets passed along, it becomes incomplete, forgotten, and, sometimes... even distorted.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: But the words inscribed on these crystals will stand the test of time. The inscription will never deteriorate, and the meaning will never get twisted.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: It's the perfect gift for a dear friend or significant other. You could even pass it down to younger generations!

choices.text: You're really pushing the sales pitch.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon's interested! Let's buy one, {NICKNAME}! We can engrave our names onto it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Then, once we find your {M#sister}{F#brother}, we can get {M#her}{F#him} to add {M#her}{F#his} name, as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That way, our names will be together forever, hehe.

choices.text: Looks like Paimon's already been hooked...

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: You deserve it! You saved me and Nechca's birthday present. It's the least I can do to repay you.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Cheven, I thought I told you—

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Don't you start acting shy too, Tlazolli! It's a great gift! I know how much work goes into one of your Blazegem Inscriptions.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Well, then... Thank you both. I'll have it ready as soon as possible. Then, I'll have you do the inscription yourself.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Nechca should be well by then. She'll be very excited to meet you.

choices.text: Good things are better with company...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, let's not get ahead of ourselves. We don't even know how expensive that would be. You sure we have enough travel funds?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hold on... this isn't part of some scheme to make us spend all our Mora, right Cheven?

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: You never know... You do look like you have some savings to spare...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #No! Don't listen to that, {NICKNAME}! You'll end up losing all your Mora!

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Haha! In any case, it's up to you.

response.speaker: Iengu
response.text: Roar!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no, it's the Tepetlisaur again! Quick, someone stop it! Paimon doesn't wanna get run over again!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Whoa! There, there!

response.speaker: Iengu
response.text: Roar...

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Also, if you don't mind, Tlazolli, I'd like you to help me repair my Blazegem Inscription.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: I dropped it when I was attacked earlier. The rope and clasp both snapped, so I haven't been wearing it.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: I tried to fix it myself, but I just couldn't get it to stay. Could you help?

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Just leave it to me. I'll make it as good as new.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: ...Thank you, Cheven... for going all that way, and—

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: It was nothing. We all just want Nechca to get better.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: ...You're right.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Iengu! Behave yourself! I'll feed you in just a second!

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: #I'll have Cheven contact you once everything's ready, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Maybe we'll even line it up with Nechca's birthday. We could even have a little party.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds great! We'll look forward to all the good food, and we'll make sure we're ready to eat!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, see you around, Tlazolli!

choices.text: See you.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Look after yourselves!

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Nechca... is going to be so happy to meet you.

choices.text: I hope Nechca gets better soon.
Might as well buy a few more as gifts...
That sounds a little too precious...
You're very persuasive...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah, let's get one! We can engrave our names onto it. Then, once we find your {M#sister}{F#brother}, {M#she}{F#he} can add {M#her}{F#his} name, as well!

choices.text: No wonder you run your own store...
Alright! Let's hear it!
Sounds like she's doing well enough to run off on her own, too.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Yes, and to run away from eating her vegetables. She's a fast one, that's for sure.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: She jumps over the chairs, hides under the table... then runs all around the house. I can hardly catch her.

response.speaker: Tlazolli
response.text: Seeing how she is now... That's already enough. I really couldn't ask for more...

choices.text: Yeah, quite a coincidence...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, guess this means we should head back down.

choices.text: Seems like it got up there on its own...?

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Again? *sigh* Alright. You two take care of Master Cheven, okay? Don't let her go anywhere dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: How is it that every single time Imix tells me not to go someplace dangerous, I end up running into danger? It's like her words have some sort of power over me... Maybe it's the Wayob's doing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The tracks end at this cliff... Could the Tepetlisaur have climbed up the mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's head up there and see.
